shadowSentences: I enjoy reading books every day.
Eating breakfast helps me focus in class.
I like to go for a jog in the morning.
Watching movies is a fun way to relax.
My favorite season is autumn because of the colors.
Traveling to new places expands my perspective on life.
Cooking new recipes allows me to express my creativity.
Listening to music while studying improves my concentration.
I often volunteer at local shelters to help my community.
Maintaining a balanced lifestyle is key to overall happiness.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel experiences.
questions: Q1: Can you describe your favorite travel experience?
Q2: What challenges did you face while traveling?
Q3: How do you think travel impacts personal growth?
Q4: What advice would you give someone planning to travel for the first time?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about time management.
questions: Q1: How do you typically manage your time during the day?
Q2: What obstacles do you encounter when trying to manage your time?
Q3: Why do you think effective time management is important?
Q4: What tips would you offer to someone struggling with time management?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about hobbies and interests.
questions: Q1: What hobbies do you enjoy in your free time?
Q2: How do these hobbies benefit your life?
Q3: What role do you think hobbies play in overall well-being?
Q4: How would you suggest someone find a new hobby?
